top10.introHtml: Ten best buys from 75 four-seat convertibles (Cars.com 16, CarGurus 30, AutoTrader 29 after filtering) between $7,000 and $15,000 within 35 miles of Media, PA. Ranked for a fun second car: sound model family and condition first, then manual gearbox, mileage and distance. Excluded: two-seat roadsters (including the 2002–05 Thunderbird and Cadillac Allante) and your exclude list (MINI, Buick, Volvo, Solara, Camaro, pre-2005 Mustang). Notes are based on listing data and known model issues; none of these cars has been inspected.

picks.whyGood: S197 Mustang GT with the 4.6L 3-valve V8 at just 80,750 miles, only 10 miles away in West Chester. Simple, robust, cheap-to-fix powertrain and a real back seat; no accidents reported on the listing.
picks.whatToVerify: Mustang GT: listen for 3-valve cam-phaser rattle at cold start, check spring perches for rust, test the top latches, and feel for 8.8 rear-axle clunk on takeoff. Look for water staining on the rear seats from top-seal leaks. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: Best fun-per-dollar in the pool: a low-mile V8 convertible from the most fixable family, right up the road.

picks.whyGood: E93 328i with the naturally aspirated N52 six, the most durable BMW engine of the era, at under 90K miles. CarGurus rates it a Great Deal and it is one of the cheapest sound cars here.
picks.whatToVerify: BMW E93: the folding hardtop is hydraulic, so listen for a straining pump and check the trunk for fluid; check valve-cover and oil-filter-housing gaskets for leaks and confirm the electric water pump and thermostat have been done. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: Cheapest well-engineered four-seat convertible in the pool; buy it if the roof cycles cleanly.

picks.whyGood: E88 128i with the N52 six and a six-speed manual at 86,671 miles; listing filtered for no accidents and a clean title. Light, balanced and genuinely fun.
picks.whatToVerify: BMW E88: check the soft-top hydraulic rams and pump, oil-filter-housing and valve-cover gaskets, and the water pump history. Test clutch bite point and synchros on the manual. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: The best driver's car here: a manual BMW convertible with sensible miles.

picks.whyGood: G37 convertible with the VQ37 V6 at 68,448 miles, a CarGurus Good Deal 19 miles away. Infiniti reliability with a three-piece retractable hardtop and a usable back seat.
picks.whatToVerify: Infiniti G37: cycle the retractable hardtop several times and listen for motor strain, check the trunk-lid seals, and look for oil-gallery gasket noise (whine) and cracked dash trim. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: Most reliable luxury hardtop in the pool; a safe low-mile pick.

picks.whyGood: E46 330Ci at only 64,358 miles; listing filtered for no accidents and a clean title. The E46 cabrio is a classic, easy-to-service BMW with the strong M54 six.
picks.whatToVerify: BMW E46: check the soft-top hydraulic pump and rams for leaks, the cooling system (radiator, expansion tank, water pump), subframe mounts and rear-window glue seam. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: Low-mile modern-classic BMW at a fair price; budget for a cooling-system refresh.

picks.whyGood: A5 Cabriolet 2.0T quattro Premium Plus at 86,962 miles, 18 miles away in Oaklyn, NJ. AWD and a well-insulated fabric top make it the most year-round car here.
picks.whatToVerify: Audi 2.0T: ask about oil consumption (piston rings) and timing-chain tensioner history, check the top's hydraulic system and water drains, and test the multitronic/tiptronic for shudder. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: Good all-weather choice if the 2.0T has documented oil-consumption fixes.

picks.whyGood: Jaguar XJS 4.0 2+2 convertible with only 46,103 miles at $7,500, with no accidents reported. The AJ16 inline-six is the most reliable XJS engine, and few cars here have this much style.
picks.whatToVerify: Jaguar XJS: inspect the sills, jacking points and rear radius-arm mounts for rust, check the top hydraulics and electrics, and look for coolant leaks and a tired 4-speed automatic. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: Cheap, low-mile classic; buy it for style and keep a repair fund ready.

picks.whyGood: S197 Mustang V6 with the 305 hp 3.7L, a strong and simple engine, at $8,652 with no accidents reported. Cheapest Mustang in the pool and very cheap to run.
picks.whatToVerify: Mustang S197: feel for 8.8 rear-axle clunk on takeoff, check spring perches for rust, test the top latches, and look for water staining on the rear seats. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: Low-cost, low-risk Mustang fun; higher miles are fine for this drivetrain.

picks.whyGood: E350 Cabriolet at 84,714 miles, 11 miles away in Philadelphia. Mercedes' 3.5L V6 and 7-speed automatic are well proven, and it is the most comfortable car here.
picks.whatToVerify: Mercedes E350: check the Aircap and soft-top hydraulics, the balance-shaft and timing-chain history on the M272/M276 V6, and the transmission conductor plate for leaks. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: The comfort pick; at the top of the budget but the nicest place to sit.

picks.whyGood: Eos Lux with only 54,896 miles and no accidents reported. The folding glass-roof hardtop gives a real coupe when closed.
picks.whatToVerify: VW Eos: clear and test the roof drains, check every roof seal for leaks and the headliner for stains, and ask about timing-chain tensioner and carbon-buildup service on the 2.0T. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: Low miles at a low price, but the roof seals are the gamble; inspect closely.

manual10.introHtml: Only two manual four-seat convertibles surfaced this refresh, both BMW 1 Series 128i. The 2010 is listed by a private seller whose description says it was built with a manual; confirm in person. Last run's 2011 135i is actually an automatic per its CarGurus listing.

picks.whyGood: Six-speed manual E88 128i with the N52 six at 86,671 miles; no accidents and clean title per the Cars.com filters. The best-balanced manual convertible in the area.
picks.whatToVerify: BMW E88: soft-top hydraulic rams and pump, oil-filter-housing and valve-cover gaskets, and water pump history. Manual checks: high clutch engagement point (worn clutch), 2nd/3rd synchro slow-shift test, throw-out bearing chirp, and weeping clutch hydraulics. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: The manual to buy this week.

picks.whyGood: Private-seller 2010 128i at $7,000; the seller describes an original manual-transmission M-Sport car with recent oil pan gasket, spark plug and radiator work. No accidents and clean title reported.
picks.whatToVerify: Confirm it is still a manual in person; the seller says the interior was swapped and the sport seats replaced. 167,000 miles, so check the soft-top hydraulics, cooling system and oil leaks closely. Manual checks: high clutch engagement point (worn clutch), 2nd/3rd synchro slow-shift test, throw-out bearing chirp, and weeping clutch hydraulics. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: Cheap manual BMW with a story; worth a look if the paperwork checks out.

mustangs.introHtml: Five unique 2005+ Mustang convertibles in budget (some are listed on more than one site; the cheapest listing is shown). One GT, four V6s, all automatics.

picks.whyGood: Only V8 Mustang in budget: 2010 GT at 80,750 miles, 10 miles away, no accidents reported.
picks.whatToVerify: S197: 3-valve 4.6 cam-phaser rattle at cold start (05–10 GT), spring-perch rust, top-latch wear, 8.8 axle clunk on takeoff, and rear-seat water staining from top-seal failure. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: The only V8 in budget and the Mustang to get, right in West Chester.

picks.whyGood: 2014 V6 with the 305 hp 3.7L at 109,452 miles, the lowest-mile V6; no accidents and clean title per Cars.com filters.
picks.whatToVerify: S197: spring-perch rust, top-latch wear, 8.8 axle clunk on takeoff, rear-seat water staining from top-seal failure. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: Solid V6 if the GT sells.

picks.whyGood: 2011 V6 Premium (first year of the 3.7L) at 119,721 miles, $9,500, no accidents reported.
picks.whatToVerify: S197: spring-perch rust, top-latch wear, 8.8 axle clunk on takeoff, rear-seat water staining from top-seal failure. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.

picks.whyGood: 2014 V6 at 121,010 miles and the cheapest Mustang here at $8,652, no accidents reported.
picks.whatToVerify: S197: spring-perch rust, top-latch wear, 8.8 axle clunk on takeoff, rear-seat water staining from top-seal failure. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.

picks.whyGood: 2014 V6 at 128,020 miles, $9,988 on AutoTrader (same car is $10,478 on Cars.com), no accidents reported.
picks.whatToVerify: S197: spring-perch rust, top-latch wear, 8.8 axle clunk on takeoff, rear-seat water staining from top-seal failure. Cycle the top fully down and up at least twice; check headliner, carpets and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and the rockers/floor pans for rust; ask for service records and run a VIN history report.
picks.bottomLine: Fine, but the others are better value.
